title: A survey on the Asplund property for spaces $C(X)$ of continuous functions
summary: The Asplund property plays an important role in Banach space theory due to its connections with differentiability properties of continuous convex functions, optimization problems, and the weak topology of Banach spaces. Motivated by the variety of nonequivalent definitions proposed in the literature for locally convex spaces, in this survey we provide a unified framework for studying the Asplund property beyond the Banach space setting.
